content_text:
Civil Designer | AutoCAD | 12d Model | Regional Infrastructure 
Design infrastructure you can actually see being built.
Proterra Group is looking for a Civil Designer to join our growing Civil Engineering team.
Working alongside our RPEQ Engineering Team, you’ll deliver practical civil designs for projects across regional Queensland, including roads, intersections, subdivisions, drainage, water and wastewater infrastructure, floodways and community facilities.
We’re proudly focused on regional Australia and the communities we work in. Our approach is practical: understand the problem, find the right solution and produce designs that are fit for purpose and can actually be built.
Most importantly, you’ll get to see the impact of your work.
What you’ll work on:
No two projects will be quite the same.
Our recent civil design projects have included:
- Residential and industrial subdivisions across regional Queensland
- Roads and intersection upgrades
- Floodway’s, drainage and pipe crossings
- Infrastructure designed to improve accessibility during flooding
- Regional waste facility upgrades
- Commercial and Local Government developments
You’ll have the opportunity to be involved beyond the design desk, working with our engineers and project teams and seeing projects progress from concept and detailed design through to construction.
About you:
We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering problems and takes pride in producing high-quality, constructible designs. 
Ideally, you’ll bring:
- Strong experience using AutoCAD and 12d Model
- Civil infrastructure design experience
- A relevant qualification in civil engineering or civil design, or equivalent industry experience
- A practical approach to developing fit-for-purpose designs
- Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with engineers, project managers and clients
Experience in roads, subdivisions, drainage, water infrastructure or Local Government projects would be highly regarded.
You don’t need to know everything. You’ll have support from our experienced engineers, while still having plenty of opportunity to take ownership of your work and help us continually improve how we deliver our designs.
About Proterra Group:
Proterra Group works with councils, businesses and communities to deliver practical engineering and infrastructure solutions across regional Queensland.  We understand regional communities because we’re part of them.
If you’re looking for an opportunity where you can work on interesting projects, develop your skills and see your designs make a real difference in regional communities, we’d like to hear from you.
You can learn more about us through the Proterra Group website, Facebook or LinkedIn.
Why join Proterra Group?
This role has been created in response to increasing demand for our civil design services and represents an opportunity to play a key role in the future growth of our business. Working across a diverse project portfolio, you will have the chance to influence the evolution of our design team and help shape the standards, systems, and processes that support our continued success.
We are seeking an experienced Civil Designer who is technically proficient, self-driven, and capable of working autonomously. Beyond delivering high-quality design outcomes, you will demonstrate the leadership potential to mentor team members and contribute to the development and growth of a design team. 
.
We offer:
- Salary + superannuation, depending on experience
- An RDO each month
- Your birthday off
- Lunch provided every workday
- Access to our Health and Wellbeing rebate 
- Flexible working arrangements
- Support for further study and professional development
- Opportunities to attend conferences and become involved with industry bodies and committees
- Access to our Employee Assistance Program
- Mentoring and professional support from experienced civil engineering professionals
We want our people to enjoy their work, continue developing professionally and have a life outside the office.
Ready to apply?
Click Apply and follow the prompts to submit your application.
For a confidential enquiry about the role, contact us at careers@proterragroup.com.au.
Applications close Friday, 27th November 2026.
